details: Controlled baseline captured across 12 test scenarios via test/phase8-performance-profiler.mjs --save-baseline into artifacts/phase8/phase8_baseline_profile.json

Identified primary hotspots: lobby chunk overdraw (3703 draw calls), unculled distant scenery (>320m), rail shadow casting overhead, scenery allocation churn during chunk candidate validation, railing post non-instanced meshes

Implemented lobby chunk culling, dynamic distance decorative culling in TrackManager, rail/coin/bogie shadow pass elimination, instanced railing posts in ModernMetroWorldBuilder, deferred scenery decoration in TrackChunk.populate, and generalised resource disposal with isShared tagging

Post-optimization profiling completed across all 12 scenarios into artifacts/phase8/phase8_optimized_profile.json. Verified 71.4% lobby draw call reduction, 46.1% moving train call reduction, zero heap/geometry leaks over 20 restarts and 10 world switches. All test suites passed: test:worldgen (57/57), test:train-gaps (86/86), test:rooftop-regression (248/248), browser rooftop (75/75), browser train gaps (6/6), character camera polish (12/12)
Build verified clean (npm run build). Report compiled to docs/phase8-performance-engineering-report.md. Ready for git commit and remote push to origin/main
